items.definition:
just
I just finished my homework.

continuing
It's still raining.

on every side of
We walked around the park.

at any time
Have you ever been to Paris.

to or at a distance
Go away from here!

by this time
I have already finished my homework.

up to the present time
He hasn't arrived yet.

one time
I only met him once.

together
We work together.

perhaps
Maybe we should go home now.

in a line; onward
We walked along the beach.

in addition; besides
What else do you need?

almost certainly
It will probably rain tomorrow.

after a long time, typically when there has been difficulty or delay
We finally arrived home after a long journey.

in an exact way; precisely
That's exactly what I meant.

normally, generally
I usually wake up early.

just, merely
I simply forgot to call him back.

in front
Go straight ahead.

without a doubt
I will certainly help you.

at a fast speed
He finished his homework quickly.

in a clear manner; obviously
He spoke clearly so everyone could understand.

without difficulty
She can easily lift that box.

two times
I have visited that city twice.

in or to some place
I left my keys somewhere in the house.

in, at, or to any place
I can't find my keys anywhere.

quickly and unexpectedly
The car suddenly stopped.

in all places
I looked everywhere for my keys.

slowly
The snail moved slowly across the leaf.

once a week
We meet weekly to discuss progress.

often, many times
He frequently visits his grandparents.

close by
The store is nearby.

often; at regular intervals
She regularly visits her grandparents.

with great attention or caution
He carefully opened the old box.

badly
He played badly in the first half of the game.

to or in the central part of a city
Let's go downtown for dinner tonight.

in a different manner
Try to do it differently this time.

in a correct manner
Please spell your name correctly.

at any time
You can call me anytime.

in a sad manner
Sadly, the concert was cancelled due to rain.

in a quiet manner
He closed the door quietly so as not to wake anyone.

in a happy way
They lived happily ever after.

nicely
She sings very nicely.

at some point in the future
Someday, I hope to travel the world.

in reverse direction
He walked backwards to avoid tripping.

happening once a year
The festival is held yearly.

on or to an upper floor or level
He went upstairs to get his book.

in a loud manner
He spoke loudly so everyone could hear him.

towards the rear
He took a step backward to avoid the puddle.

outside
We love spending time outdoors.

on every occasion
Everytime I visit, I learn something new.

in an unusual or surprising way
Strangely, the lights went out just as he entered the room.

inside a building
It's raining, so we should play indoors.

no less than
At least try your best.

audibly; not silently or in a whisper
She read the story aloud to the children.

in a way that shows enthusiasm or affection.
She greeted him warmly.

toward a lower place or level
The ball rolled downwards the hill.

in or to some unspecified place
I need to go someplace quiet to study.
